clue.text: Member leads groups with signs of mourning

indicators.note: the first piece goes in front of the next, leading it

parts.note: an arm is a limb, a member of the body
bands are groups of people or musicians

explanation.surface: A club member heads a procession of mourners.
explanation.definitionFit: Black bands worn round the sleeve are a traditional token of grief at a funeral.

clue.text: Intimidates the French surrounded by weapons

indicators.note: the French article sits enclosed within the word for weapons

parts.note: arms are weapons
la is French for 'the' (feminine)

explanation.surface: A bully frightens French people by brandishing guns.
explanation.definitionFit: To alarm someone is to frighten them, a near synonym of intimidating them.

clue.text: Brood about one's ill-treatment

indicators.note: the word for brooding goes around the other piece

parts.note: to brood is to muse, ponder at length
one is I, the Roman numeral, followed by the S of the possessive

explanation.surface: Someone sulks over the poor way they have been treated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One's' is read as I'S: the Roman numeral I for one plus the S of the possessive.
explanation.definitionFit: Abuse or wrong handling of something or someone counts as ill-treatment.

clue.text: Terrible actor in trouble with debts

indicators.note: letters that are in trouble are in disorder, so these are rearranged

parts.note: IOUs are written acknowledgements of debts

explanation.surface: A dreadful performer is struggling financially as well.
explanation.definitionFit: Something atrocious is extremely bad, a strong synonym for awful.

clue.text: Record playing in the small hours — Mood Indigo?

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record
a show that is on is playing
the small hours are very late at night, so late

explanation.surface: A record spinning late at night: the Ellington standard Mood Indigo.
explanation.walkthrough: Mood Indigo is a Duke Ellington tune; indigo is blue, and a blue mood is sadness.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling blue, as an indigo mood suggests, means being dejected and beyond comfort.

clue.text: Pet for the ancient mariner

parts.note: a sailor's pet would be a hound of the ocean, but the phrase really means an old, experienced sailor

explanation.surface: What animal would Coleridge's Ancient Mariner keep?
explanation.definitionFit: A grizzled old sailor is nicknamed this, matching an ancient mariner, while 'pet' plays on the canine half.

clue.text: Note overdue transport

parts.note: E is a musical note
late means overdue

explanation.surface: A notice that the bus or train is running behind time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Transport' looks like the noun for vehicles; here it is the verb meaning to fill with delight.
explanation.definitionFit: To transport someone emotionally is to carry them away with joy, to thrill them.

clue.text: A product of good stock

parts.note: sounds like someone of fine pedigree, but means a payout from shares that do well

explanation.surface: Someone of fine breeding, a well-bred offspring.
explanation.definitionFit: Shares in a company are stock, and a payment of profit to shareholders is what good stock yields.

clue.text: Excellent publicity arranged by family members

parts.note: grand means excellent
ads are advertisements, publicity

explanation.surface: Relatives have organised some superb promotion.
explanation.definitionFit: Grandfathers are relatives two generations up, members of the family.

clue.text: Hard to fathom why corruption engulfed good man and king

indicators.note: the word for corruption swallows the other two pieces

parts.note: abuse, as in abuse of power, is corruption
ST, short for saint, a good man
R, for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: It is baffling why vice should have swallowed a virtuous man and a monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Abstruse ideas are obscure and difficult to understand.

clue.text: A vital change for a country

indicators.note: the letters are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A crucial change of direction for a nation.
explanation.definitionFit: This Baltic state is a nation in northern Europe.

clue.text: A despatch note?

parts.note: looks like a delivery slip, but despatch also means to kill, so it is the order for an execution

explanation.surface: An everyday shipping document accompanying a parcel.
explanation.definitionFit: A document authorising an execution is literally a written order to dispatch someone.

clue.text: Love food?

parts.note: recalls Shakespeare's 'If ... be the food of love, play on' from Twelfth Night

explanation.surface: A simple question: are you a foodie?
explanation.definitionFit: Orsino in Twelfth Night calls melody and song the food of love.

clue.text: Such a discussion gives opportunity for falling out

definitions.text: Such a discussion gives opportunity for falling out

parts.words: Such a discussion gives opportunity for falling out
parts.note: a debate with no fixed limits; read literally, its ends are open so things could fall out

explanation.surface: A free-ranging debate invites quarrels.
explanation.definitionFit: A discussion with no set conclusion or limits is unrestricted, and something with unclosed ends lets things drop out.

clue.text: Educated at home?

parts.note: suggests home schooling, but means a pet taught to be clean indoors

explanation.surface: Was the child home-schooled?
explanation.definitionFit: A dog or cat taught to relieve itself outdoors has been schooled for life in a dwelling.

clue.text: Missile base and plant

parts.note: an arrow is a missile
a root is a base or foundation

explanation.surface: A military rocket launch site and a factory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plant' reads as a factory alongside a missile base; it is the botanical sense.
explanation.definitionFit: This tropical plant yields a starchy flour used in cooking.

clue.text: Mature pop band, all as old as each other

definitions.text: all as old as each other

parts.note: to age is to mature
a group is a pop band

explanation.surface: A veteran rock band whose members are all the same vintage.
explanation.definitionFit: People of similar years are classed together into a bracket by birth year.

clue.text: Good enough to get by?

definitions.meaning: literally able to be passed, so a road or obstacle one can get by

explanation.definitionFit: Adequate work is acceptable, and a clear road is one that can be traversed.

clue.text: Craftsmen with inflationary effects on their products

definitions.text: Craftsmen with inflationary effects on their products

parts.words: Craftsmen with inflationary effects on their products
parts.note: sounds like economics, but these artisans literally inflate their vessels with breath

explanation.surface: Artisans who push up prices of their goods.
explanation.definitionFit: Makers of vases and bottles shape molten silica by puffing air into it, literally inflating their work.

clue.text: She gets tangled with men to become engaged

indicators.note: letters that are tangled are mixed up, so these are rearranged

explanation.surface: A woman gets involved with several men before her engagement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Engaged' suggests betrothal; here it is gears or nets locking together.
explanation.definitionFit: Gear teeth that interlock are said to mesh or engage, so to entangle is to become caught up.

clue.text: Poetically skilful

parts.note: a word meaning experienced or skilled, that also suggests put into verse

explanation.definitionFit: Being well practised in a subject means skilled, and the word also echoes rhymed lines of poetry.

clue.text: Most agree it could be a useless eyesore

indicators.note: the letters could be rearranged into something else

explanation.surface: General agreement that a building is an ugly waste of space.
explanation.walkthrough: The huge gas holders that dot British towns are now largely disused and widely thought ugly.
explanation.definitionFit: Redundant gas-storage holders loom over many towns as derelict structures.

clue.text: State of the sea, say

indicators.note: say signals that the word is spoken, so its sound matters

parts.note: the main is an old word for the open ocean

explanation.surface: Asking about the condition of the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: This New England state is one of the fifty in the USA.

clue.text: Flinch when college head tucks into port, say

indicators.note: the selected letter goes inside the drink

parts.note: port is an example of a fortified wine

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: The college principal recoils while drinking port.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tucks into' suggests eating or drinking; here it places C inside WINE.
explanation.definitionFit: To recoil or grimace in pain is to flinch.

clue.text: Albion maverick may be released

indicators.note: an unorthodox, wayward arrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: A wayward West Bromwich Albion player could be let go by the club.
explanation.definitionFit: A suspect let out of custody pending trial against a surety has been freed conditionally.

clue.text: Her rank prohibits one's admission

indicators.note: the word for prohibits admits, lets in, the other piece

parts.note: bars means prohibits
taken as ONES

explanation.surface: Her social standing keeps others out.
explanation.definitionFit: A noblewoman holding the lowest peerage title has this rank.

clue.text: Parts of firearms?

definitions.meaning: slang for guns, as in a 'piece' carried by a gangster

explanation.surface: Components of guns.
explanation.definitionFit: Bits of a whole are its fragments, and in slang a handgun is also so called.

clue.text: On the way had an urge and joined up

parts.note: ST is short for street, a way
itched means had an urge

explanation.surface: Someone on the road felt an impulse and enlisted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'joined up' suggests enlisting; here it is sewing together.
explanation.definitionFit: Sewing pieces together with needle and thread is fastening them with seams.
